title: Port Security Violation Modes
description: Lock down Fa0/1 with port security and compare the three violation modes.
scenario: Lock down Fa0/1 with port security and compare the three violation modes.

concepts.title: What is Port Security?
concepts.body: Port security limits how many MAC addresses can send frames into a port. It only works on access (or trunk) ports, not dynamic ports.
concepts.code:
SW1(config-if)# switchport mode access
SW1(config-if)# switchport port-security

concepts.title: The Three Violation Modes
concepts.body: protect drops offending frames silently. restrict drops them AND logs + counts violations. shutdown puts the port in err-disabled (this is the default).
concepts.code:
SW1(config-if)# switchport port-security violation protect
SW1(config-if)# switchport port-security violation restrict
SW1(config-if)# switchport port-security violation shutdown

concepts.title: Verifying
concepts.body: "show port-security" lists every secured port with its mode and violation count. "show port-security interface fa0/1" gives per-port detail.
concepts.code:
SW1# show port-security
Secure Port  MaxSecureAddr  Violation
Fa0/1        2              Restrict
